description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
2027 Overview
Summer associates will be immersed in AbbVie’s in-house legal and compliance teams, learning about and handling real-world matters under the supervision of AbbVie attorneys and compliance officers. Summer associates will work with one of the following departments within the in-house legal or compliance team for the duration of the summer internship:
Patent Legal Academy
Work on a wide variety of patent prosecution and IP (patent, trade secret) litigation-related tasks, which may include drafting materials for U.S. and foreign patent prosecution, listing patents in the FDA’s Orange Book, analyzing freedom-to-operate issues, addressing contractual issues, evaluating issues related to biopharmaceutical patent and trade secret litigation, and participating in strategy meetings with in-house and outside prosecution and litigation counsel.
Clinical R&D Legal Academy
Work on a wide range of clinical trial-related legal and regulatory matters in support of AbbVie’s therapeutic pipeline. Provides support for AbbVie’s global clinical research-based pharmaceutical business, including: clinical trial design; executing transactions required to get a clinical trial up and running, conducting legal analysis relating to patient-related matters such as informed consent, recruitment and retention strategies, and integration of novel technologies into AbbVie’s clinical trials; and providing global regulatory advice relating to AbbVie’s pipeline programs.
Corporate Legal Academy
Work in key corporate legal areas such as corporate financing, securities compliance and disclosure, compensation and benefits, and corporate governance.
Strategic Transactions Academy
Substantive legal work related to acquisition transactions as well as new and existing collaborations; assessing antitrust risks associated with mergers, acquisitions, and licensing transactions; and venture capital transactions.
Global Commercial Legal Academy
Support comprehensive legal and strategic guidance to Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs teams. Advise on a broad range of matters involving the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Office of Inspector General (OIG), and other applicable laws, regulations, and industry guidance relevant to our business.t various pharmaceutical and aesthetics brands by partnering with attorneys to deliver
Operations, Privacy, and Technology Academy
Support the Operations function, which is responsible for AbbVie’s product manufacturing, procurement of goods and services, quality assurance, supply chain, and various aspects of product development; support the Legal Privacy team; and work on various Legal Technology projects, including those related to AI and the use of data across the enterprise.
Litigation/Employment/Compliance Academy
Work alongside attorneys across AbbVie’s Commercial Litigation, Employment, Labor & Immigration, and Legal Compliance teams.  Opportunity to work across a broad array of litigation and counseling matters, including areas such as product liability, antitrust, contractual disputes, visa and other immigration issues, and compliance with relevant laws including the Anti-Kickback Statute, Food, Drug & Cosmetic Act, Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, and many others.
Office of Ethics and Compliance Academy
Gain hands-on experience by supporting the Compliance team in activities such as conducting policy assessments, developing and supporting training initiatives, monitoring business practices and participating in investigations to help promote compliant conduct under healthcare and pharmaceutical industry codes, laws, and regulations. This role will also involve cross-functional collaboration with teams in Operations, Commercial Brands, R&D, Privacy, and International.
***
All summer associates will research and present on a legal or compliance issue related to their work and will have the opportunity to meet and work with AbbVie’s in-house and outside counsel and compliance professionals, including partnering closely with both a manager and mentor who will both provide ongoing guidance and professional development.
By the end of the summer, AbbVie 1L Summer Associates should have attained:
practical experience working for a global biopharmaceutical company in an interesting and evolving area of law,
an understanding of how in-house attorneys and compliance officers provide value to their company as trusted advisors to the business,
leadership opportunities and experience building business relationships effectively, and
meaningful writing and communication development.
How to Apply
Submit your application, which includes your resume and related information at the AbbVie Career Site AND Email a single PDF consisting of the documents set forth below to AbbVieLegalAcademy@abbvie.com.
Current resume
A letter explaining your interest in the AbbVie 1L Legal Academy Program, including your ranking of your top three choices among the internship programs listed above.

Undergraduate transcript (unofficial)

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Drug Substance Engineering Internship Overview
Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie Interns.
Micronization of drug substance is a critical process in API manufacturing for ensuring downstream critical quality attributes. Micronization processes such as pin milling and jet milling leverage feed rate control to optimize the process performance, and while feed rate is well understood for many powder systems there is a gap in understanding the feed rate control of poorly flowing materials in micronization techniques.
The Drug Substance Engineering Intern within Product Development, Science, and Technology (PDS&T) will help establish a systematic approach to understand how the physical properties of powder systems impact their feeding performance in micronization processes.
Key responsibilities include:
Experimental studies to understand and characterize powder properties
Evaluate performance of micronization techniques (i.e. jet mill, pin mill) with various feed mechanisms
Analyze data and trends to identify signatures for process performance
Develop and verify computational models
Summarize and present findings in departmental and cross-functional settings
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a PhD in Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or other related field
Must be enrolled in university for at least one semester following the internship
Expected graduation date between December 2027 – June 2028
Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to comminution processes
Experience with physical characterization techniques (flowability, adhesion, cohesion, bulk density, laser diffraction particle size determination)
Proficient in computational modeling techniques (e.g., fluid dynamics, discrete element method)

2027 Formulation Sciences Internship Overview

Join AbbVie's Pharmaceutical Technology team within Product Development, Science, and Technology (PDS&T) to support late-stage formulation development for a solid oral dosage form. Supporting Reliability Engineer as needed.

Currently enrolled in university, pursing a bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or other related field.
Must be enrolled in university for at least one semester following the co-op
Expected graduation date between December 2027 – June 2028

About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
Allergan markets a portfolio of best-in-class products that provide novel treatments for the central nervous system, eye care, medical aesthetics and dermatology, gastroenterology, women's health, urology, anti-infective and cardiovascular therapeutic categories. With commercial operations in approximately 100 countries, Allergan is committed to working with physicians, healthcare providers and patients to deliver innovative and meaningful treatments that help people around the world live longer, healthier lives.
Our success is powered by our world-class team’s commitment to being Bold for Life. Together, we build bridges, power ideas, act fast and drive results for our customers and patients around the world by always doing what it is right.
At Allergan you will have the opportunity to thrive in a fast-paced, strategic environment where bold, innovative thinking isn’t just welcomed, it’s encouraged. Across all functions, we relish the opportunity to help our people fulfill their potential. Our rapid growth strategy means plenty of opportunities to step into the spotlight.
Customer Experience Lead (CXRIV) Customer Service Leads are responsible for staff training, team communications, staff auditing/performance, and assistance to the Supervisor/Manager with project management.  In addition, a lead will provide secondary support for inbound, and escalated inquiries processing transactions as needed.  Leads are responsible to assist in oversight of team member order processing, order auditing, and resolution of issues that may prevent orders from shipping.  In addition, leads may be required to work offsite and travel on a limited basis.  Under general supervision, processes customer requests related to product programs in a timely, accurate and professional manner. Fosters the growth and customer relationships by creating positive customer and team interactions and building strong relationships. The employee must conduct their work activities in compliance with all Allergan internal requirements and with all applicable regulatory requirements.  Allergan internal requirements include compliance with ethics, environmental health and safety, financial, human resources, and general business policies, requirements and objectives.

Position Summary
The Director, SOX Lifecycle & Enablement owns the end-to-end SOX program lifecycle for the enterprise and serves as the senior deputy within the IC SOX Center of Excellence. The role directs the annual risk assessment and scoping process, the risk and control matrix, the Section 302/404 certification process, and enterprise deficiency management, and coordinates the network of Business Unit SOX Leads across the organization. The Director also directly manages the U.S. business unit advisory portfolio (Commercial, Operations, and the Accounting Center of Excellence), the program’s highest-complexity areas, operating as a player-coach.
The role is central to a multi-year modernization of the SOX program, including the transition of management testing to an internal Testing & Analytics Hub, expanded automation and continuous monitoring, and an AI-enabled controls platform. During this transition, the Director is expected to be hands-on: directly managing stakeholder relationships, deficiency evaluations, and external auditor positions while building the operating rhythm of a maturing program. The change management and enablement mandate (training, communications, and adoption across control owners and BU SOX Leads) is an explicit part of the role.
Key Responsibilities
SOX Lifecycle Ownership
Direct the annual SOX risk assessment and scoping process, including materiality-driven scoping decisions and coordination with the external auditor on scope alignment.
Own the enterprise risk and control matrix: rationalization, updates for business and system change (acquisitions, ERP and data programs), and documentation quality standards.
Operate the Section 302/404 certification process, including quarterly sub-certifications and support for management’s quarterly and annual ICFR conclusions.
Own deficiency management as an enterprise process: intake, evaluation and severity assessment, aggregation analysis, remediation monitoring, and reporting for executive management and Audit Committee materials.
Manage external auditor (EY) coordination on scoping, reliance, and deficiency positions; prepare and defend management’s technical positions.
Business Unit Advisory
Directly manage the U.S. advisory portfolio (Commercial, Operations, Accounting Center of Excellence): control design consultation, readiness for business and system change, and first-line support to senior finance stakeholders.
Serve as the escalation point for significant deficiency assessments, contentious auditor matters, and issues bearing on quarterly certification conclusions across all business units.
Supervise and develop the Senior Manager responsible for the OUS and FSS advisory portfolio.
BU SOX Leads Network
Coordinate the enterprise network of Business Unit SOX Leads (approximately 12 business units): operating cadence, quarterly forums, standardized deficiency and change intake, and consistency of practice across units.
Change Management & Enablement
Lead training, communications, and adoption for program changes, including the Workiva-resident lifecycle, evidence standards, and continuous monitoring outputs as they deploy.
Oversee Workiva program administration (assessments, certifications, reporting) through the Senior Analyst, and partner with the AI & Analytics Enablement leader on platform direction.
Leadership
Manage and develop two direct reports; contribute to talent development across the Center of Excellence.
Partner with the Testing & Analytics Hub, AI & Analytics Enablement, and IT SOX leaders to operate an integrated program.
Qualifications
Required
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in audit and internal controls, with significant SOX program leadership at a large public company or serving large public company clients.
CPA or CIA (or equivalent certification).
Deep working knowledge of PCAOB AS 2201, the COSO 2013 framework, SEC Sections 302/404, and deficiency evaluation and aggregation practice.
Demonstrated experience managing external auditor relationships and defending technical positions.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills with senior finance leadership.
Preferred
Big 4 experience at the Senior Manager, or Director level in audit, risk assurance, or controls advisory.
Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other large multinational environments, including acquisition integration and ERP or data transformation programs.
Experience with Workiva (or comparable GRC platforms) and with programs transitioning from outsourced to internal testing models, automation, or continuous monitoring.

The Warehouse Group Leader is the person responsible for ensuring that all activities pertaining to material movement are handled in a timely manner while maintaining the highest levels of compliance and quality. This position will be required to resolve any issues that arise pertaining to material movement in the warehouse and requires a high level of independence, with major decisions made in conjunction with leadership. Decisions and actions have a direct impact on the operation’s efficiency, effectiveness (cost, time, and quality) and compliance. This position requires the ability to understand the customer’s needs and appropriately prioritize the overall workload.
Responsibilities
This position is expected to lead through example, demonstrating exemplary attendance, leads meetings, tracks, and reports on KPI’s, maintains a positive attitude to assignments. He/she does not have direct supervisor/manager duties such as performance evaluation or disciplinary responsibilities but will provide related feedback to leadership as needed.
Participate in responses to departmental, corporate, and governmental audits. Aid in the control of all critical non-inventory items. • Interface daily with key stakeholders to coordinate workflow with other departments/areas of the business to ensure business needs are met

Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
Responsible for cross-training in multiple areas of the operation while maintaining a low level of quality mistakes.
Accurately receive and inspect inbound product/material for infestation, overages, shortages, and damages (OS&D).
Efficiently and correctly pick customer orders for shipment, ensuring that the correct number and type of product is picked. Verify quantity, quality, labeling and address with the customer’s order to ensure outgoing shipments are complete and accurate.
Transfers and locates material/product to general storage areas or shipping locations.
High School Diploma or GED with 5+ years of related experience preferably within a pharmaceutical operations setting.
Accurately complete basic math calculations. Ability to read and understand training documents, product labeling and warehouse signage written in English.
Pass medical screening and/or background checks conducted by local, state, and federal authorities.
Self-motivated with ability to work in a fast-paced positive team-oriented environment, with moderate supervision an emphasis on customer satisfaction.
Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand
5+ years working with ERP system, preferably SAP. Familiarity with Microsoft office products, general computer skills and RF scanners required. Ability to analyze, think creatively, decide, an effectively communicate verbally and written.
Very strong working knowledge applying DEA, TSA, FAA, IATA, DOT, IMDG and/or FTZ compliance regulations for the receiving and shipping of materials.
Capable to lift 50 lbs., and/or more with assistance. Able to bend, reach, stoop, climb, stand and walk for entire shift of 8 hours or more. Ability to work in an atmosphere range of -20°C to 30°C (-4°Fto 86°F)

description:

At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Workforce Management Analyst role is integral to our success. You’ll use your deep experience to manage multiple markets and call-type groups that will help advise an ever-changing operational model. As a member of the team, you will partner closely with leadership to establish our process for short-term forecasting and drive scheduling for our world-class customer experience team. Learn the latest in emerging WFM tools and software, as AbbVie continues to build its Workforce Management capabilities at scale.
Own long, mid, and short-term planning cycles - from forecasting, scheduling to real-time management. Provide enhancements to the existing locked forecast process
Ensure data integrity within telephony, IVR, WFM, and CRM tools by reporting data, routing issues, and other technical issues. Track and normalize volume
Assist with the daily WFM responsibilities to include daily staff requirements, vacation/holiday schedules, and PTO bidding for the Customer Service department
Utilize data analytics to track and analyze performance of individuals, teams, and overall workforce. Monitor key metrics such as productivity, schedule adherence, and customer abandonment rate.
Partner closely with multiple cross-functional teams including BPO strategic sourcing to understand capacity, headcount, location strategy, ops performance, volumes, arrival patterns, handling times, budget allocation vs. spend
Ad-hoc reporting request, KPI build-out, attendance capturing, and dashboard creation to convert raw data into actionable insights.
Statistical data modeling and testing to build out accurate forecast volumes and productivity assumptions across all channels and lines of businesses using historical data, trends, seasonality, and events. Quickly identify and explain fluctuations in volume, AHT, and other assumptions to adjust resources accordingly
Maintain forecasts and capacity plans at various levels, including volume, AHT, workload, shrinkage, and other staffing KPIs
Ensure optimization of forecast accuracy at all levels through reporting and analysis of deviations
Work with our internal and external partners, ensuring our support center operates in the most efficient manner possible
Partner with operational leadership to shepherd and drive new innovative, successful metrics
2+ years of experience in workforce planning/management
MS Excel skills and experience in working with the following Microsoft Suite and Reporting Platforms: VBA, MS Excel, MS Access, SQL, and/or MS Access skills required
Experience with forecasting volume and schedule generation
Experience gathering unstructured data to produce insights and reporting using Excel
Problem-solving and analytical experience
Experience communicating to various levels within an organization
Excellent time management track record

BA or BS degree in business or a related field is preferred
Experience with Nice inContact

Global Alliance Director - WPP
This role serves as the  General Manager of one of Adobe’s most strategic global agency alliances , WPP, with end-to-end accountability for  strategy, growth, and business performance . Operating as the senior-most leader for the partnership, this executive will define and execute a multi-year vision to  scale revenue, expand market influence, and drive co-innovation across Adobe’s cross-cloud ecosystem .
The GM will own the alliance as a business—shaping joint investments, orchestrating global go-to-market (GTM), and ensuring measurable outcomes across pipeline, bookings, and customer success. This leader will act as the primary executive interface between Adobe and the partner, aligning C-suite stakeholders and mobilizing global teams to deliver differentiated solutions and sustained growth.
This is a highly visible leadership role requiring a combination of  strategic thinking, commercial rigor, and executive influence , with the ability to operate across a complex, matrixed global organization.
Key Responsibilities
General Management & Alliance Strategy
Own the global alliance as a business, including vision, strategy, and multi-year growth plan aligned to Adobe’s corporate priorities
Define and drive joint investment strategy, ensuring focus on highest-value opportunities across industries, geographies, and solution areas
Identify, incubate, and scale new revenue streams, business models, and innovation opportunities
Revenue Growth & Market Expansion
Lead end-to-end revenue accountability, including partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, and long-term growth targets
Architect and scale global co-sell motions, including alignment with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, to increase deal velocity and win rates
Personally engage in strategic deal shaping, executive sponsorship, and closing of high-impact opportunities

Serve as the primary executive relationship owner with the partner, building deep, trust-based engagement at the C-suite level
Align partner executives with Adobe’s senior leadership to drive shared priorities, investments, and accountability
Represent the alliance externally through industry events, thought leadership, and executive forums
Joint Solutions & Category Leadership
Lead the development and global GTM of differentiated joint offerings that deliver measurable customer outcomes – needs familiarity with agency services offerings and associated Mar-Tech/Ad-Tech.
Champion Adobe’s cross-cloud strategy within the partner ecosystem to accelerate adoption of integrated solutions
Position the alliance as a market leader through co-innovation, IP development, and industry-specific solutions
Global Operating Model & Governance
Establish and adhere a world-class governance model, including executive steering committees, QBRs, and performance management frameworks

Ensure operational excellence and consistency across regions while enabling local market agility

Build scalable engagement models that increase leverage, efficiency, and speed of execution

15+ years of experience in global alliances and global agencies, strategic partnerships, and/or enterprise sales leadership
Proven success operating with global accountability for revenue growth and partnership performance at scale
Demonstrated ability to influence C-level executives and lead within complex, matrixed global organizations
Strong commercial acumen, including pipeline development, deal structuring, and forecasting

This is an exciting role for a design leader who can operate at the intersection of design quality and operational scale. You are the right person for this job if you are a creative problem solver with a passion for customers, strong program management instincts, and the ability to drive high-volume design work efficiently and consistently. In this role, you will own the entire Design PERF workstream — from deciding which projects need design, to prioritizing and resourcing the work, to executing and delivering design solutions for equipment replacements, brand refreshes, and other in-store improvement projects. Not every PERF project requires design intervention, and a key part of this role is building the judgment and systems to identify which ones do and get them done well.
You will serve as the primary design partner to the PERF Construction Management team, equipment and procurement partners, and store operations stakeholders. You will define the standards and toolkits that make design delivery repeatable at scale, and you will be the senior design voice for the program, ensuring every project is grounded in strong design thinking and delivered efficiently. We are looking for someone who is comfortable moving quickly, communicating clearly at all levels, and taking end-to-end ownership in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
We are a fast-moving business unit where everyone is entrepreneurial, wears many hats, and works effectively in a highly collaborative environment. The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver with strong program management instincts, a passion for customers, and the ability to build scalable design systems that work across a high-volume portfolio.
Key job responsibilities
- End-to-End Workstream Ownership: Own the entire Design PERF workstream, establishing the processes and standards that govern how design requests are received, prioritized, resourced, and delivered.
- Design Intake and Prioritization: Establish criteria for which PERF projects require design intervention and own prioritization across the portfolio, triaging requests by urgency, strategic importance, and operational impact
- Resourcing: Match project needs to internal and external design capacity and proactively identify gaps.
- Design Execution: Lead and execute design work for PERF scope, equipment replacements, breakroom and restroom refreshes, and in-store improvement projects to brand standards and operational requirements.

A typical day involves triaging new PERF design requests, advancing active design packages, and coordinating with the Capital Planning and Construction teams to ensure design handoffs are clean and complete. You will regularly interface with store operations leaders to ground design decisions in real store context, partner with procurement on equipment specifications, and advance process improvements that help the team scale. The Enterprise Design team leads the transformation of our existing grocery locations through strategic remodels and innovations. title: Energy Analytics, TPM, Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation
description:
The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.
You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.
Key job responsibilities
● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.
● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.
● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.
● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).
● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.
● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.
● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.
● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.
● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)
● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit
● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.
● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.
● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.
● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.

- Establish adoption measurement and reporting so progress and risk are visible before a change fails, own the judgment on how to respond when adoption stalls, and build the documentation and processes that make new ways of working durable beyond any single individual.
A day in the life
You spend your day building the organization's capacity to change. You partner with leadership to shape the change strategy, then own how it comes to life: assessing why change stalls and fixing it at the root rather than rescuing one rollout at a time. You sequence a portfolio of concurrent changes so the organization adopts them without saturating, and build the methodology and standards that let every team run change well. title: Technical Program Manager, Fauna
description:
Fauna Robotics is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own quality for robot behavior and data collection. You will write and maintain the test suite that every release and every new policy goes through. That suite has two layers. The first is a core set of regression tests that confirms, every time, that the robot's locomotion, manipulation, mode transitions, and autonomy hand-offs still behave as expected. The second, and harder, layer goes looking for the subtle problems a routine pass will miss: failures that appear only in particular sequences of events, under particular loads, or in the interaction between the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot. You will run these tests yourself on experimental hardware, write clear and reproducible reports, and work with the engineering teams until each issue is understood and resolved.
You will also help keep the data we collect at a high quality through hands-on, on-site work with the robots: supporting benchmark collections, reviewing recorded episodes, and tracking data problems back to their root cause, whether that's the operator, the teleoperation stack, the robot, or the pipeline. As new collection tasks come out of research, you'll pilot them on hardware with the data scientists who designed them, validate the tools and methods they depend on, and say whether they're ready to run at scale. You'll be the go-to person for bringing new data collectors and QA team members up to speed on our teleoperation stack, our data collection management and ingestion tools, and the basics of finding, triaging, and reporting bugs.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the release test suite for robot behavior and teleoperation. Write, maintain, and run test plans for updates to the teleoperation stack, internal and external software releases, and new robot policies.
- Maintain a repeatable core regression suite that every change must pass, and extend it with deeper, adversarial test cases designed to surface subtle, intermittent, or interaction-dependent failures across the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot.
- Run tests hands-on with experimental robots and in simulation. Write detailed, reproducible test reports and bug reports, and give clear go/no-go recommendations for each release and each new policy.
- Track issues through to resolution with software, controls, hardware, and ML teams. Keep a record of known issues, how to reproduce them, and workarounds.
- Support data quality through hands-on, on-robot testing: help run benchmark collections, review recordings against task requirements, flag problem episodes, and feed the failure patterns you find back to the teams that own the process and tooling.
- Pilot new data collection tasks alongside data scientists and research engineers: translate research intent into an executable protocol, run the first sessions yourself, and report back on feasibility, throughput, and data quality.
- Validate the data collection tools and methods behind each task before they're relied on at scale — define acceptance criteria, quantify failure modes, and make the go/no-go call. Iterate on task setups, scene design, and annotation schemas where the data doesn't hold up.
- Onboard and mentor new data collectors and QA team members on our teleoperation stack, the data collection management system, the ingestion and annotation tools, and how to report bugs well.
- Coordinate the day-to-day test and benchmark activities that data collectors take part in. Work with the data collection program manager, who owns the data collectors' work and priorities, to schedule robot time, sessions, and test coverage.
- Assess the spaces and resources that testing and collection depend on — lab and home-like environments, robot availability, headsets and peripherals, fixtures and props — and flag what's missing before it becomes a bottleneck.
Keep test documentation, checklists, SOPs, and run books up to date as the robot, the app, and our policies change.
Work safely around experimental hardware, and hold the people you train to the same standard.
About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 3+ years of experience in quality assurance, test, or validation of hardware or hardware-plus-software products (robotics, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, XR, or similar), or in technical program management for such products
- Experience writing and running structured test plans and SOPs, and producing detailed, reproducible test and bug reports with logs, timestamps, media, and system context
- Experience working hands-on with physical robots or other experimental hardware in a lab or test environment, including diagnosing failures that span hardware, firmware, and software

title: Designer, Design Team
description:

title: Display Technologist
description:
Apple's Hardware Technologies team develops the innovative displays that define our products and delight our customers worldwide. Experience in Python and MATLAB for large-scale data collection and analysis

Deep understanding of OLED device principles
Experience with the latest consumer electronics display technologies
Ability to communicate technical problems and challenges clearly and effectively across cross-functional organizations

title: Embedded Networking Engineer
description:

title: Engineering Manager, Private Cloud Compute Inference Routing
description:
At Apple, iCloud Platform Engineering builds the server stack behind Push Notifications, iMessage, FaceTime, iCloud, iCloud Private Relay and Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the backbone of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence. We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead PCC inference routing. These systems send every inference request to the right compute across a global, multi-region fleet, while keeping latency low, availability high and PCC's privacy guarantees intact.
This is a technically grounded leadership role for someone who thrives at scale, can bring clarity to complex and fast-changing environments, and is energized by building both systems and teams. You'll guide architectural direction, scale operational practices and develop the engineers and leaders who will shape how Apple delivers cloud inference.
Routing LLM inference at Apple's scale takes systems that adapt to changing demand, available capacity and failures while keeping latency low and accelerator utilization high. As the fleet grows across regions and cells, routing must account for capacity and health across the whole fleet, not just a single site. PCC adds a basic architectural requirement: request content stays encrypted outside trusted compute nodes. You'll lead the design of routing and scheduling strategies within this privacy model. Together with inference and security teams, you'll evaluate techniques such as cache-aware request placement and prefill/decode disaggregation. Your scope includes the inference AI gateway layer, where requests are authenticated, metered, prioritized and streamed back to clients, all without exposing request content.
This work has broad reach. Every improvement to routing makes Siri AI and Apple Intelligence faster and more reliable, and makes better use of Apple's inference capacity. In your first year, you'll be expected to grow a high-performing organization, set a clear technical roadmap, and measurably improve routing latency, availability and fleet utilization.
Minimum qualifications: Extensive software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of leading teams that design, build, and operate large-scale distributed systems in production environments—whether through direct management, indirect oversight, or a combination thereof
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing engineers and leaders
Experience delivering API gateways (preferably inference AI gateways), request routing, load balancing, scheduling, or traffic management systems at scale
Expertise of LLM inference serving, including request routing, KV-cache placement and reuse, prefill/decode disaggregation, and the tradeoffs between latency, throughput and accelerator use
A record of shipping highly reliable systems in high-availability environments, including leading incident management, on-call and reliability practices
Strong technical depth: capable of contributing meaningfully to architectural and design discussions with senior engineers, with a server development background in Java, C/C++, Go or Swift
Ability to drive alignment and execution across teams in complex, matrixed environments
Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline or equivalent professional experience
Preferred qualifications: Proven leadership in developing LLM inference serving or routing platforms (e.g., llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo, vLLM, SGLang, or managed inference services)
Experience building or running inference AI gateways and their core behaviors: token-based rate limiting and usage metering, multi-model routing with fallback, retries and circuit breaking, and streamingresponse handling
Track record of scaling teams and organizations during rapid growth while maintaining top-tier hiring and engineering standards
Experience delivering capacity tiers, reservations or QoS for high-volume workloads, and improving accelerator utilization through cross-region, capacity-aware routing

title: Engineering Manager, Security Server Applications - Enterprise Technology Services (ETS)
description:
Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. title: ML Optimization Engineer, ASE Efficiency

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Answers Knowledge and Information - Proactive
description:
The Information Intelligence team is creating groundbreaking technology for artificial intelligence, machine learning and natural language processing! The features we create are redefining how hundreds of millions of people use their computers and mobile devices to search and find what they are looking for. Our universal search engine powers search features across a variety of Apple products, including Siri, Spotlight, Safari, Messages and Lookup. We also develop state-of-the-art generative AI technologies based on Large Language Models to power innovative features in both Apple’s devices and services on the cloud. As part of this group, you will be doing large scale machine learning and deep learning research and development to improve Open Domain Question Answering (using both structured knowledge graph data and unstructured web data) and Summarization as well as developing fundamental building blocks needed for Artificial Intelligence. This involves developing sophisticated machine learning and large language models (LLMs) to understand user queries, retrieve and rank relevant documents across multiple sources and synthesize information across documents to provide user with a direct answer that best satisfies their intent and information seeking needs. Additionally, you will research and develop the state-of-the-art LLMs for summarizing personal data such as emails, messages, and notifications. You will also work with researchers and data scientists to develop, fine-tune, and evaluate domain specific Large Language Models for various tasks and applications in Apple’s AI powered products and conduct applied research to transfer the cutting edge research in generative AI to production ready technologies.
As a member of our fast-paced group, you’ll have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products from Apple. We are looking for highly motivated machine learning engineers and researchers having strong machine learning and deep learning fundamentals with hands-on experience in fine-tuning deep learning and large language models.
Minimum qualifications: Experience in modeling user behavior including personalization, online learning and recommendation systems
Experience working with machine learning or LLM model development for various NLP tasks and RAG applications including prompt engineering, training data collection and generation, model fine-tuning and model evaluation
Experience working with Python and at least one of the deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX
Preferred qualifications: PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
At least 2 years of experience in various state-of-the-art techniques related to LLM fine-tuning in 1 or more of the following areas -- Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT) with Rejection Sampling, Preference-based fine-tuning techniques (e.g RLHF, Reward model, DPO, PPO, GRPO etc.), Parameter efficient fine-tuning techniques (e.g LoRA), Hallucination reduction and factual accuracy improvements, Designing and implementing safety guardrails
Consistent track record of researching, inventing and/or shipping advanced machine learning models
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to work with cross-functional teams

title: Manager, Engineering Program Manager, Intelligent System Experience
description:
Why Apple? We live in a mobile and device driven world where knowledge of the physical world around us is needed. We rely on this knowledge to get around, to learn about our environment and to enable spectacular new features for custom applications. Apple is meeting those needs as robustly and as creatively as possible and is interested in people who want to help meet that commitment. The success we strive to achieve will be the result of very skilled people working in an environment which cultivates creativity, partnership, and thinking of old problems in new ways.
We are seeking a talented manager to lead a high performing team of project managers that support the entire development lifecycle across various functions including: Software Engineering, Product Management, QA, Design, and Marketing while fostering innovation, collaboration, and operational effectiveness. Your leadership will be crucial in delivering high-quality software solutions for Intelligent System Experiences to the market.
In this role you will lead, coach, inspire and develop a team of Engineering Project Managers that are tasked with driving complex projects across our platforms, responsible for delivering exciting features while continuing to meet our tight deadlines and high quality levels. You will be the central hub bringing together different teams from Software, Hardware, and Design, among other teams, all in the name of delivering on groundbreaking technology across all our operating systems.
Minimum qualifications: 10+ years experience in software engineering project or program management, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of the software development lifecycle from inception to launch.
3+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, career development, performance management, and leading high-performing teams of project managers
Demonstrated history of successfully launching customer-facing software products with a focus on operational rigor and continuous improvement
Extensive expertise in managing processes across the software development lifecycle with a focus on metrics and efficiency.

Proven experience delivering written and verbal communications, status updates, and presentations to stakeholders at all levels of an organization
BS in Computer Science or related field
Preferred qualifications: Demonstrated ability to design, define, and successfully scale new operational processes from scratch

title: Principal Applied Research Engineer/Scientist, Siri Labs
description:
Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be.
As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world's most widely used AI assistants, powered by our next-generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on-screen awareness, built with privacy from the ground up. Your work will have direct, meaningful impact for users across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS. This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and human-centered design, shipping technology that is centered around users and their needs.
At Apple, we don’t just build products; we create experiences that enrich the lives of billions. You have the unique opportunity to seamlessly integrate foundational AI research with world-class hardware and software, bringing cutting-edge technology to billions of users. Your work will have a far-reaching impact, setting precedents for how autonomous, deeply personalized AI technologies enrich lives across our entire product ecosystem.
We are seeking a Principal Applied Research Engineer to drive breakthrough innovation across self-improving systems, agentic memory, and deeply personalized autonomous multi-agent systems. You will shape next-generation intelligent architectures that learn continuously, retain and reason over persistent memory, coordinate across agents, and translate frontier research into scalable product experiences. This unique opportunity places you at the forefront of innovation, working on projects that redefine user experiences through advanced machine learning.
Minimum qualifications: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field; or equivalent practical experience delivering zero-to-one LLM productization.
Deep expertise in transformer-based LLMs and multi-modal foundation models, with a focus on integrating text, vision, and audio with cross-modal attention.
Hands-on mastery across the model lifecycle, including pre-training, fine-tuning, performance optimization, and safety alignment.
Expertise in designing AI agents for complex reasoning while navigating the unique challenges of on-device compute constraints.
Preferred qualifications: Demonstrated ability to influence high-level architecture decisions and effectively advocate for novel research directions to product leadership.

title: Privacy Architect
description:
Apple's Wallet, Payments, and Commerce teams are redefining how people pay, access, and interact with financial services. Our work powers Apple Pay, Apple Cash, Tap to Pay, and connected services that enable commerce at global scale. Privacy is a fundamental human right at Apple, and foundational to that ambition.
We are seeking a Principal Engineer to own privacy architecture for Wallet, Payments, and Commerce engineering. You are the technical authority for privacy across WPC. You will define how WPC collects, processes, retains, and protects user data across a global, regulated ecosystem, and own our approach to user consent, data minimization, logging architecture, and privacy risk.
You will lead through influence. The Privacy Compliance team runs assessments, monitoring, and training. You supply the frameworks, decisions, and escalation judgment that make their work consistent and scalable, and you own the multi-year roadmap.
You will work with leadership to define a comprehensive privacy strategy, contributing to technical discussions regarding current and emerging privacy requirements. You will partner with Apple central privacy teams e.g. Apple Privacy Legal and User Privacy to evaluate existing and new offerings against global privacy standards and design architectural enhancements to uphold Apple’s foundational principle that privacy is a fundamental human right.
Minimum qualifications: 12+ years of experience in privacy engineering, security engineering, or related architecture roles
Deep expertise in privacy engineering (data minimization, consent architecture, logging design, privacy-preserving patterns at production scale) and command of global regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA), translated into engineering decisions
Track record of defining standards or platforms adopted across large, complex engineering organizations, leading through influence over senior engineers and compliance practitioners who do not report to you
Ability to make defensible architectural decisions under regulatory ambiguity and align legal, product, and engineering leadership
Experience using generative AI to build tools, automate risk identification, or accelerate engineering workflows in regulated environments
Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive briefings and regulator-facing material
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Preferred qualifications: Payments, financial services, or other regulated-domain experience, including audit expectations, partner privacy requirements, and frameworks such as NIST, SOC 2, and ISO 27001
Hands-on experience building shared privacy platforms (consent management, PII detection, data lineage)
Experience representing engineering in external regulatory engagements, partner privacy reviews, or industry working groups

title: Product Designer
description:
At Apple, we create experiences that help people do more with technology. The Ads & Business
Design team brings that same care to the tools businesses use to connect with customers
across Apple.
We’re looking for a Product Designer to help shape Apple Ads. You’ll make sophisticated
advertising workflows feel clear and approachable, from creating campaigns and managing
creative to understanding performance and deciding what to do next. You’ll work on
experiences used by businesses of different sizes, helping them grow while giving them
confidence and control.
Our team is also exploring how intelligence can make these tools more useful: turning insight
into action, simplifying complex work, and helping advertisers make informed decisions. We’re
looking for someone who can deliver excellent product experiences today and help us explore
what comes next.
As a Product Designer on the Ads team, you’ll own meaningful parts of the advertiser
experience from early exploration through launch and refinement. You’ll partner closely with
product managers, engineers, researchers, content designers, and other designers to

You’ll use flows, prototypes, and detailed designs to make ideas tangible and testable. You’ll
bring care to interaction, visual design, accessibility, and the quality of the shipped experience.
You’ll also help evolve shared patterns so that the platform becomes more coherent as it grows.
This role is well suited to a designer who enjoys untangling complexity, has strong craft, and is
comfortable moving between near-term product needs and longer-term possibilities.
Minimum qualifications: 5+ years of product design experience and a portfolio demonstrating strong interaction and
visual design, clear problem solving, and shipped work.
Experience designing complex workflows for web-based products, professional tools, or
comparable software.

Interest or experience in designing useful applications of AI, recommendations, automation,
or conversational interfaces.

Keynote.

title: Product RF Design Engineer
description:
You will have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to deliver outstanding performance for wireless products. As a member of the Product RF Design team, you will be at the forefront of wireless technology as we push the boundaries of achievable performance in wireless for innovative products. You will become part of a hands-on product development team that develops and influences current and future generations of Apple products.
We’re looking for dedicated and motivated engineers with good fundamentals in one or more areas of RF/wireless and electromagnetic theory, antenna design, system integration, & wireless communications.
Product RF Design Engineers should have a broad-based knowledge in RF architecture, design, integration and manufacturing. They have deep theoretical and practical knowledge in one or more areas of electromagnetic theory, RF and Wireless circuit design, communication theory, and product design trade-off. They use electromagnetic and system simulation, hands on prototyping, test and measurement to understand complex system and sub-system interactions, implications to product level design, and manufacturing trade-offs to enable mass production.

Coursework or experience in antenna/RF design, wireless communications, EM, or circuits.

Knowledge of electromagnetic simulation tools.
Hands-on experience with RF lab instrumentation.
Ability to debug Desense issues and characterize noise sources.
Experience with production environment and statistical analysis.

title: RF System Integration Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for wireless technologies? Do you want to impact the wireless experience for billions of users? Come and join us! You will become part of a hands-on development team that furthers engineering perfection, creativity, and innovation with a prime focus on wireless accuracy and performance. Dynamic, encouraging people and innovative technologies are the norm here. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish! You will have the opportunity to contribute to the design and validation of RF and wireless systems across Apple’s newest products including iPhones, Watches, iPads and others. You will help advance a system that guarantees the most efficient, consistent wireless performance across all of Apple’s products in large volumes. To design such a system requires excellent fundamentals in wireless systems and communications theory as well as sound programming practices.

You will collaborate with chipset manufacturers, test equipment vendors as well as our in-house antenna and RFHW design teams to analyze wireless performance data and tackle the plethora of technical challenges it takes to deploy groundbreaking wireless features with impeccable quality.

Intuitive understanding in one or all of the following areas: RF Transceiver Blocks, Communications theory, RF Parameters

Ability to read and write clean, clear, efficient and understandable code in one or more relevant programming languages (C, C++, Python).
International and domestic travel is required (~15%)

5+ Years of industry experience or equivalent. Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming and scalable software design principles
Recent experience in developing test solutions for current and upcoming wireless RF standards (e.g. WiFi 802.11xx, Bluetooth 5.0, 5G, NFC, UWB)

Energy and aim to thrive in a start-up like environment.

title: RFIC Characterization and Validation Lead
description:
The wireless RFIC team architects, designs, and validates radio transceivers integrated into complex wireless SoCs. Our transceivers have powered wireless connectivity solutions for Apple wearable products, enabling the smallest form factor at the lowest power envelope. You will have the opportunity to do innovative development in transceiver design while working closely with systems and product teams at Apple. In this role, you will lead the RFIC validation and characterization team: set the validation strategy and plan, guide engineers through bring-up, characterization, and calibration development, and serve as the technical owner of RF silicon readiness for our wireless SoCs. You will stay hands-on in the lab and in the test code. Would you like to join us and lead this dynamic team?
In this role, you will be a key leader of our team, delivering end-to-end RF integration solutions for our advanced wireless SoC products.
You will enable the entire product lifecycle, from pre-silicon emulation and design development through mass production.
You will own the critical first bring-up of the RF in our wireless SoCs, final silicon validation, and compliance with rigorous standards.
You will own the validation methodology and schedule across pre-silicon (emulation and simulation-based validation), first silicon, characterization, and the hand-off to production test.
You will report status and risk to design, systems, integration, and program management.
This is a unique opportunity to deepen your technical expertise across both hardware and software domains, including wireless transceiver architecture, RF systems, DSP, embedded systems, and the full productization of world-class products.
Your work will involve hands-on bench testing, debug, and system characterization to ensure our RF IPs meet and exceed performance targets.

Strong scripting and automation skills in Python (highly desired), Perl, TCL, C++, or similar languages.
Hands-on experience with standard RF test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, vector signal analyzers, and signal generators.
Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, wireless transceiver architectures, and digital communication systems.
Strong knowledge of RF, PLL, and wireless system measurements (e.g., IP3, NF, ACPR, phase noise, lock time).
Experience with RF PCB design, layout, and debug.
Familiarity with RFIC block-level schematics and design/simulation environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including reporting to senior management.

Prior people management or large-scale project management experience, demonstrating strong leadership.
Strong RF background and a solid understanding of RF systems fundamentals.
Experience with wireless standards (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Thread/802.15.4) and their compliance measurements.
Exposure to RFIC design and simulation/verification, including pre-silicon validation of RF and digital interfaces.

Experience developing production calibration and ATE test flows and handing them over to manufacturing.

title: Security Manager, SEAR
description:
Apple engineers have always focused on one person when they build software — the person who will use it. Working in our Software Group (SWE) you’ll see why every Apple product and service feels intuitive and simple, and why every aspect of this group’s work is built around a respect for the customer’s needs.
Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture team (SEAR) focuses on security needs. Passionate about safeguarding, we believe the best defense is a good offense. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most sophisticated operating systems, that means finding vulnerabilities first.
We are now making our security evaluation pipeline fully AI-native, from vulnerability discovery to validation, using the most advanced AI capabilities available. Can you make a difference on this scale? Join our extraordinary team of security researchers, engineers and AI specialists, and help discover and patch Apple products' vulnerabilities before they ship.
We are looking for a manager to lead several teams that develop the capabilities and tooling supporting both offensive and defensive security projects. You will bring a product-oriented mindset to complex systems, shaping our end-to-end security evaluation pipeline and driving its evolution toward an AI-native approach.
Your organization will include software and security engineers and AI engineers who bring advanced AI capabilities into every stage of the work. Your teams will partner very closely with Apple's security researchers, who are your primary customers and collaborators. You will make sure they have the tools that make the difference: you will understand their workflows, anticipate their needs, and turn their feedback and ideas into reliable products that multiply their impact. You will set technical direction, grow and mentor your teams, and ensure that what they build is adopted and used across Apple.
Working alongside a wide variety of teams and vendors, your influence will be felt throughout Apple's products, such as iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. The tools your teams build will support security assessments in the areas of platform security, hardware/software boundary, wireless technologies, and more.
The typical activities of your teams include creating innovative offensive and defensive security tools, building and scaling fuzzing infrastructure and techniques, and developing AI-driven vulnerability discovery and analysis systems. They also include operating research tooling as production services, and consulting with researchers and other teams on both hardware and software, so that proofs of concept, design and specification reviews, and assessments benefit from the best possible tooling. The scope is as diverse as it is essential.
This position requires someone with strong technical skills, the ability to lead and grow multidisciplinary engineering teams, and a customer-focused mindset toward researchers. You should also have a passionate desire to secure systems by enabling the people who show how they can be broken.
If this is you, we'd love to hear from you!
Minimum qualifications: 5+ years of experience managing software development and/or tooling teams
Extraordinary leadership and organizational skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of iOS and macOS security architecture
Familiarity with applied ML and LLM-based agent systems and their evaluation
Familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization/Kubernetes, observability) for scaling internal tooling

title: Security Site Reliability Engineer - Apple Service Engineering
description:
People at Apple don't just build products, they craft the kind of experiences that have revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. title: Senior Data Scientist, Apple Ads
description:
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers’ experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they’re looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses.
Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, and MLS Season Pass. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
The Accessories team is seeking a highly motivated Firmware Engineer with a strong foundation in engineering principles and a deep passion for new technologies. title: Senior Mechanical Prototyper & Lead
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. title: Senior Network Engineer, Infrastructure Services
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.”
Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Infrastructure Services is part of IS&T and the foundation of Apple's global network operations — managing data center equipment and systems to deliver compute, storage, and networking services for teams across Apple, including its internal developer community. From individual facilities to a worldwide network, Infrastructure Services ensures the technology underneath everything works without question.
Apple’s Global Network Services (GNS) team supports Apple’s Global Backbone and Internet peering infrastructure! We're a team of seasoned professionals that maintain and operate one of the world’s largest service provider based backbone to connect all of Apple’s businesses globally. We are growing and building the fastest and most reliable network backbone to meet Apple’s phenomenal scale and unique requirements.
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, testing, and deployment of our global backbone network. title: Software Engineer - Generative UI, Input Experience
description:
A generated interface is only as good as the pieces it's made from. Give a model the wrong pieces and it fails, producing something generic or broken. Give it the right ones and it can make something a designer would be proud of.
We're looking for an engineer with a designer's eye to build those pieces: the views, layouts, and APIs that generated interfaces are built from. The goal is to make the right result the easy one to write, for people and models.
You'll join a small, newly formed team working closely with Apple's design studio, and you'll own the UI layer that generative interfaces are built on. Your APIs will have two kinds of users: engineers, and the models generating interfaces in real time. Most of the work is finding the right abstraction. Which layout decisions should a view make by itself? Which should be stated as intent? Which should never be exposed at all? An API that answers those questions well lets a model write a few lines and get something that feels native.
The hard cases are the ones designers usually solve by hand: tight space, many sizes, content whose length and shape aren't known until it arrives. You'll build components that handle them without anyone drawing each one.
With designers, you'll prototype quickly until something feels right, then turn it into a principled, well-named API with a small surface. With the generation side, you'll study how models use your APIs and change them until good results are the default. Along the way you'll partner with design, AI, and UI framework teams across Apple.

title: Market Analyst
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. ABOUT THE ROLE

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns a fleet of distributed batteries and the households we serve into a power business that makes money. As a Market Analyst, you’ll know how much Base is earning, where it could lose money, and how it will make money in the next market.

You’ll own P&L (profit and loss) reporting and risk tracking across our battery fleet and retail operations. You’ll build the pricing models behind what we charge members, recommend hedges, and work with Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy to figure out how Base makes money in each new market. Base already does this in ERCOT. Your first job is to do it in PJM.

This role suits someone with a few years of experience in power markets, retail energy, or a related analytical field. You’ll own real decisions early.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a bottoms-up retail pricing model for PJM that builds upon our ERCOT model.

 - Bring PJM into our risk system and P&L reporting, so we know the margin we earn and how to buy supply.

 - Identify new market opportunities and work closely with stakeholders from Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy teams to bring them to reality.

 - Recommend changes to Base’s hedging strategy in ERCOT and PJM, and track our exposure against risk limits.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Energy markets knowledge: you understand wholesale market basics in ERCOT and PJM, including how power is bought, hedged and settled. You know how retail pricing and operations work.

description:
About the Team
The Global Safety and Security team advances DoorDash through the protection of people, property, operations, brand, and reputation. We deliver value through agility, technology, and a people-first mindset—creating environments where employees and guests feel safe, welcome, and confident.
As DoorDash continues to evolve its workplace experience globally, our Corporate Safety and Security team is reimagining how physical security integrates seamlessly into every employee and guest interaction. The Associate, GOC Analyst will play a key role in designing and delivering this next-generation security experience.
About the Role
We are hiring a GOC Analyst to support DoorDash’s 24/7 Global Operations Center. Reporting to the GOC Manager, this role is responsible for real-time monitoring, incident triage, and operational response to protect DoorDash’s people, assets, and operations. As a frontline operator, you will serve as the first line of defense during emerging incidents—monitoring systems, assessing risk, executing SOPs, and escalating issues quickly and accurately. In addition to core operational response, you will apply foundational analytical skills to validate information, distinguish signal from noise, provide clear operational context that supports timely escalation and informed decision-making. You’ll operate in a high-tempo, follow-the-sun environment where clarity, discipline, and sound judgment are critical to maintaining operational resilience.
You are excited about this opportunity because you will…
Operate the GOC in Real Time: Monitor dashboards, alerts, inbound reports, and open-source signals to identify security, safety, and operational incidents as they emerge.
Execute Incident Response with Precision: Triage incidents, follow established SOPs, and support incident command activities through accurate documentation, coordination, and information validation.
Maintain Situational Awareness: Track ongoing incidents, relevant global events, and operational conditions to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of risk across shifts and regions.
Apply Foundational Analytical  Tradecraft: Conduct initial fact-finding, source validation, and contextual analysis to distinguish signal from noise and support effective escalation.
Support Escalation and Decision-Making: Identify when issues exceed defined thresholds and escalate to the GOC Manager or Risk Intelligence team with clear, structured, and decision-ready information, without owning strategic risk interpretation.
Ensure Seamless Shift Handover: Produce concise shift reports and conduct disciplined handovers that capture incident status, risk context, and outstanding actions.
Contribute to Operational Excellence: Participate in drills, retrospectives, and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen GOC readiness, workflows, and analytical rigor.
Operate Calmly Under Pressure: Demonstrate professionalism, composure, and sound judgment during fast-moving or high-impact incidents.
We are excited about you because you bring…
Operations Center Experience: 3+ years in a GSOC, GOC, SOC, or comparable 24/7 operations or incident response environment.
Incident Management Fundamentals: Working knowledge of incident triage, escalation protocols, and operational playbooks.
Foundational Analytical Skills: Ability to assess information quality, identify trends or anomalies, and provide clear operational context during incidents.
Basic OSINT Familiarity: Comfort using open-source tools and publicly available information to validate events and support situational awareness (training provided as needed).
Strong Operational Judgment: Ability to assess risk, prioritize tasks, and act decisively under pressure.
Technical Fluency: Comfort working across monitoring dashboards, ticketing systems, communication platforms, and basic analytics tools.
Clear Communication Skills: Ability to document incidents clearly and communicate effectively with leaders and cross-functional partners.
Discipline and Reliability: Proven ability to follow process, maintain attention to detail, and perform consistently across rotating shifts.
Growth Mindset: Willingness to learn new tools, analytical techniques, and operational best practices within a structured operations environment.
Schedule Flexibility: Ability to work rotating shifts as part of a 24/7 global operations model.
Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent professional or military experience.

description:
